name: AXFRA Illuminated Stage Backdrop
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se pueden ajustar iluminación, escala y estilo visual del fondo, manteniendo la estructura general del letrero AXFRA y la composición del escenario.

backdrop.main_feature: Giant illuminated AXFRA lettering dominating the center of the stage
backdrop.signage_style: massive uppercase block letters constructed from hundreds of bright warm-white concert bulbs, inspired by classic arena rock stage signage
backdrop.signage_position: centered above the performers, spanning most of the stage width
backdrop.signage_visibility: All five letters A-X-F-R-A must be clearly readable, accurately spelled, unobstructed and brightly illuminated
backdrop.secondary_feature: additional illuminated stage panels beneath the AXFRA sign
backdrop.side_panels: symmetrical rows of illuminated speaker-stack style panels
backdrop.style: spectacular classic arena rock stage design
